description: Service-auth JWT interop vectors. Each token was produced by the TypeScript reference implementation or another JOSE signer, and `ts` records what @atproto/xrpc-server verifyJwt did with it at the pinned clock. `petrel`, where present, documents a deliberate difference.

vectors.name: ts-k256-lxm
vectors.description: createServiceJwt, 60 s, lxm bound, aud with service fragment

vectors.name: ts-k256-lxm-highS
vectors.description: the same token with S replaced by n - S; the reference verifies JWTs with allowMalleableSig

vectors.name: ts-k256-lxm-der
vectors.description: the same token with the signature re-encoded as ASN.1 DER; not a JWS signature (RFC 7518 3.4)

petrel.reason: Petrel requires the 64-byte JWS encoding by default; DER is accepted only with signatureOptions .allowMalleable

vectors.name: ts-k256-no-lxm
vectors.description: createServiceJwt without lxm, bare-DID aud; receiver does not check lxm

vectors.name: ts-k256-no-lxm-but-required
vectors.description: the lxm-less token presented to an endpoint that requires a method binding

ts.message: missing jwt lexicon method ("lxm"). must match: app.bsky.feed.getFeedSkeleton

vectors.name: ts-k256-upload-30min
vectors.description: what the official app requests for video upload: lxm com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob, 30 minute lifetime

vectors.name: ts-k256-1h
vectors.description: the longest lifetime the reference PDS issues from getServiceAuth: one hour

vectors.name: ts-k256-2h
vectors.description: a two hour token: longer than any reference PDS issues

petrel.reason: exceeds the default one hour lifetime ceiling; accepted when the ceiling is raised

vectors.name: ts-k256-expired
vectors.description: expired one minute before the pinned clock

vectors.name: ts-k256-wrong-audience
vectors.description: minted for another service

ts.message: jwt audience does not match service did

vectors.name: ts-k256-bare-audience-for-fragment-service
vectors.description: bare-DID aud presented to a service that expects its DID with a service fragment

ts.message: jwt audience does not match service did

vectors.name: ts-k256-wrong-lxm
vectors.description: minted for another endpoint

ts.message: bad jwt lexicon method ("lxm"). must match: app.bsky.feed.getFeedSkeleton

vectors.name: ts-k256-rotated-key
vectors.description: signed with the new key after a rotation; the cached key fails, a forced refresh returns the new one

vectors.name: ts-k256-wrong-key
vectors.description: signed with a key the issuer never published; refresh returns the same key

ts.message: jwt signature does not match jwt issuer

vectors.name: ts-k256-issuer-with-service-fragment
vectors.description: legacy issuer form did#service (pre Spring 2026), as labelers sent

vectors.name: ts-k256-did-web-issuer
vectors.description: did:web issuer

vectors.name: openssl-k256-lowS
vectors.description: signed by node:crypto (OpenSSL), which does not normalize S; this sample is low-S

vectors.name: openssl-k256-highS
vectors.description: signed by node:crypto (OpenSSL), which does not normalize S; this sample is high-S

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-typ-at-jwt
vectors.description: header typ at+jwt: a token of another kind, validly signed

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-typ-refresh-jwt
vectors.description: header typ refresh+jwt: a token of another kind, validly signed

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-typ-dpop-jwt
vectors.description: header typ dpop+jwt: a token of another kind, validly signed

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-no-typ-no-iat-no-jti
vectors.description: only the claims the reference verifier requires: iss, aud, exp

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-kid-atproto
vectors.description: kid header naming the default key, as the Spring 2026 specification allows

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-kid-other
vectors.description: kid header naming a key the receiving service does not accept

petrel.reason: the specification says receivers must only accept specific key ids; the reference verifier does not read kid yet

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-wrong-alg-for-key
vectors.description: header alg names the other curve

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-alg-none
vectors.description: header alg none

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-issuer-not-a-did
vectors.description: iss is a handle

ts.message: jwt iss is not a valid did

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-missing-exp
vectors.description: no exp claim

vectors.name: handbuilt-k256-duplicate-claim
vectors.description: payload JSON repeats aud; JSON.parse keeps the last value

petrel.reason: Petrel rejects JSON with duplicate members instead of picking one

vectors.name: ts-k256-tampered-issuer
vectors.description: payload rewritten to another issuer, signature kept

ts.message: jwt signature does not match jwt issuer
